name: Capterra
requirements: B2B software products — Capterra is a business software marketplace.
Free basic listing via the G2 Digital Markets vendor portal (Capterra, GetApp, Software Advice, and UpCity are now under G2 Digital Markets after G2's acquisition closed Feb 2026).
Vendor account required at app.g2digitalmarkets.com (formerly digitalmarkets.gartner.com — now 301-redirects to app.g2digitalmarkets.com).
Search Capterra first — listings are often auto-created for known SaaS; claim the existing listing rather than creating a duplicate.
preparation: Product name and short description (~150 chars) plus a longer definition-first description (what it does, who for, outcome).
Category selection — Capterra's taxonomy differs from G2's; pick the category buyers actually search.
Pricing type (Free/Freemium/Subscription/One-time), starting price, free-trial flag, deployment options (cloud/SaaS/web/iOS/Android).
Standardized feature checklist for your category — check all applicable features.
workflow: Go to https://www.capterra.com/vendors/sign-up/ or the batch URL https://app.g2digitalmarkets.com/get-listed/start.
Create/claim the product listing in the G2 Digital Markets vendor portal.
Claim each site separately from the same cabinet — Capterra, GetApp, and Software Advice are separate listings with separate descriptions/screenshots.
Complete profile fields, upload assets, verify via company email.
After approval, collect reviews (Capterra Review Collector tool; ~5 reviews targets category-listing inclusion). Optional PPC campaigns are managed in the same cabinet.
watchFor: vendor portal domain changed: digitalmarkets.gartner.com now redirects to app.g2digitalmarkets.com — old bookmarks dead.
PPC upsell in the same cabinet — third-party notes cite ~$500/mo minimum budgets; the basic listing itself is free.
Duplicate listings happen if you don't search/claim first.
Reviews are shared across the Capterra/GetApp/Software Advice network but NOT with G2 (no shared review pool).
The get-listed app page returned 403 to a plain fetch — use a real browser.
countsAsLive: A public product page on capterra.com (and optionally GetApp/Software Advice) showing description, pricing model, screenshots, and a reviews section — marked claimed once vendor verification completes.
unknowns: Exact review/approval timeline for new listings.
Current PPC minimums and pricing (third-party figures only).
Whether single sign-on or shared billing with G2 exists post-acquisition (reported: none).
